title: Extracellular vesicle α-synuclein topology reveals disease-associated conformers in brain and blood
title_zh: 细胞外囊泡α-突触核蛋白拓扑揭示脑血中疾病相关构象
abstract: Abstract Parkinson’s disease (PD), dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB), and multiple system atrophy (MSA) are unified by pathological α-synuclein (αSyn) aggregation, yet diverge in terms of the cellular distribution of pathology and clinical phenotype. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) have emerged as potential mediators or biomarkers of αSyn pathology, but whether their molecular constituents in the brain reflect disease-specific processes or conformations remains unknown. Here, we combined EV isolation, electrochemiluminescence, quantitative mass spectrometry and nanoscale single-vesicle imaging by direct stochastic optical reconstruction microscopy (dSTORM) to map the topology, epitope exposure and cellular origin of αSyn in EVs isolated from post-mortem PD, DLB, MSA, and healthy control (HC) brains and assessed the tractability of these molecular signatures in blood. Proteomics and immunoblotting of EV lysates isolated from human brains confirmed that they were highly purified and derived from neurons and glial cell subtypes. Across diseases, αSyn association with EVs exhibited distinct patterns: In PD and DLB, both total αSyn levels normalised to CD81 and the percentage of neuronal (L1CAM+) EVs with aggregated αSyn as detected by aggregate-preferring antibodies, were increased, whereas in MSA, aggregated αSyn was detected primarily in neuronal and to a lesser extent glial EV subpopulations without an increase in total EV-associated αSyn. Further epitope mapping by dSTORM identified a distinct αSyn conformational arrangement, as detected by antibodies against an epitope spanning αSyn residues 34–45, that was enriched on the surface of L1CAM+ EVs in MSA compared to PD. This N-terminal immunoreactive conformer was tractable in serum and enriched on the surface of L1CAM+ EVs from MSA compared to PD patients or controls. Collectively, our findings suggest that the epitope accessibility and topology of EV-associated αSyn proteoforms, rather than their abundance alone, discriminate synucleinopathy subtypes, offering a framework for a blood-based conformational stratification of these disorders.
abstract_zh: 摘要：帕金森病（PD）、路易体痴呆（DLB）和多系统萎缩（MSA）因α-突触核蛋白（αSyn）异常聚集而相互关联，但在病理分布和临床表现上存在差异。细胞外囊泡（EV）已被视为αSyn病理的潜在介导者或生物标志物，但其在脑中的分子成分是否反映疾病特异性过程或构象尚不清楚。本文结合EV分离、电化学发光、定量质谱和直接随机光学重建显微镜（dSTORM）对PD、DLB、MSA及健康对照（HC）脑后死样本中EV的αSyn拓扑、表位暴露和细胞来源进行绘图，并评估这些分子特征在血液中的可追踪性。对人脑EV裂解液的蛋白组学和免疫印迹确认其高度纯化，来源于神经元和胶质细胞亚型。不同疾病中，αSyn与EV的结合呈现不同模式：在PD和DLB中，归一化至CD81的总αSyn水平以及含聚集αSyn的神经元（L1CAM+）EV比例均升高；而在MSA中，聚集αSyn主要在神经元及少量胶质EV亚群中检测到，且总EV相关αSyn未升高。进一步通过dSTORM进行表位映射，发现针对αSyn残基34–45的抗体识别到一种在MSA中比PD更富集于L1CAM+ EV表面的αSyn构象。该N端免疫活性构象在血清中可追踪，并在MSA患者的L1CAM+ EV表面富集，优于PD患者或对照组。综上所述，我们的研究表明，EV相关αSyn蛋白变体的表位可及拓扑结构，而非单纯丰度，能够区分突触核蛋白病亚型，为基于血液的构象分层提供了框架。
